_about: 034's copy of each piece 035 publishes (Path 11 P1; read by npm run check:publisher). 034 is its own page for good (Devon, 2026-10-07), so a forked piece stays forked; what must not happen is a fix landing in one copy of a 'same' piece and not the other, which is the R61-R63 drift. A 'same' piece that differs: port the fix, or move it to 'forked' with a sentence. A 'forked' piece that became the same: move it to 'same' in that commit. --ledger rewrites 'same' only.

forked.brBuildOpts: 034's name list also serves its compare and sub-coverage tabs.
forked.brRenderMenu: 034's menu rows call brMenuPick (its compare tab picks two names) instead of brChoose.
forked.brOnKey: 034's Enter calls brMenuPick instead of brChoose, as its menu does.
forked.brSetMode: 034 has six tabs to 035's three: free period, compare and sub coverage each have a branch.
forked.brChoose: 034's search box and render also handle its sub-coverage tab (brRenderSub).
forked.brDayRows: 034's day table takes the teacher and draws a personal-note box per mod (br_personal_notes_v1).
forked.brRenderTeacher: 034's teacher card has My schedule (br_home_teacher), the door sign, a PNG download and share buttons; it escapes with brEscHtml.
forked.brRenderGroup: 034's group card has share buttons; it escapes with brEscHtml.
forked.brGeoFloorSVG: 034's floor drawing takes opts.crop to show the region near a room; it escapes with brEscHtml.
forked.brMiniMapHTML: Only the escaper differs: 034 calls its own brEscHtml where 035 publishes escHtml.
forked.brGroupMapHTML: Only the escaper differs: 034 calls its own brEscHtml where 035 publishes escHtml.
forked.brCheckStaleness: 034 reads PUBLISHED_DATA.publishedOn defensively, without 035's typeof guard.

absent.brDirSteps: Path 11 P6 increment 2: a route's moves in sv-routes.js routeSteps()'s words; 034 has no directions.
absent.brRenderDirections: Path 11 P6 increment 2: the Directions tab; 034 has no such tab.
